visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a high-definition close-up shot of a person's hand holding four colorful Japanese omamori (amulets) with character designs: My Melody, Godzilla, Hello Kitty, and Ultraman. The hand moves slightly to show the texture of the fabric. The background is a bright red wooden pillar of a shrine, partially obscured, with white paper strips tied to a rope. (2) The scene transitions to a medium shot of a man wearing a olive brown beanie and a blue scarf. He holds the orange Godzilla amulet close to his face, looking directly into the camera with a slight smile. The background is a slightly blurred outdoor urban setting with bare winter trees and a gray building. (3) A wide shot establishes the location as a Japanese shrine, Tsunashiki Tenjinsha. The frame captures stone pillars inscribed with Japanese characters and a traditional torii gate. Several people carrying backpacks are seen ascending the stone staircase toward the main shrine building under bright, natural daylight. (4) The camera focuses on the shrine's facade, showing the intricate wooden architecture and the 'shimenawa' rope with white paper 'shide' streamers hanging above the entrance. A wooden plaque with blue and gold details is mounted prominently. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the stone and wood. (5) A sign inside a glass display case provides information about the "Godzilla Omamori" in Japanese text, including its specific selling hours. A hand enters the frame and points toward the text to emphasize the information. The glass reflects the surroundings, but the text remains legible. (6) A series of quick cuts showcase various character amulets displayed in the glass cabinet, including Kuromi, Hello Kitty, and Ultraman. Each amulet is placed on a white surface with pricing and labels. The lighting is bright studio-style illumination within the case, making the colors pop. (7) The man appears again in a selfie-style shot, smiling and winking while holding the Godzilla amulet. He then holds the Ultraman and Godzilla amulets together for a comparison shot. Finally, all four amulets are shown together in his hand against the background of the shrine's red accents.
